name: Conformal field theory
summary: Belavin, Polyakov and Zamolodchikov classify critical 2D models via Virasoro.

name: Vertex operator algebras
summary: Borcherds and FLM axiomatise vertex operators to build the moonshine module.

name: Monstrous moonshine
to: finite group theory and modular forms
summary: Borcherds proved Conway-Norton monstrous moonshine using the Monster vertex algebra and generalised Kac-Moody algebras.

name: Moment problem for class-group statistics (Sawin-Wood)
summary: A general theorem on when moments determine a distribution of group-valued random objects was used to recover class-group distributions and to correct earlier predictions.

name: Quantum groups from statistical mechanics
summary: Algebraic structures behind the Yang-Baxter equation of solvable lattice models are formalised as deformations of enveloping algebras, linking to knot invariants and representation theory.

name: Sullivan's dictionary: rational maps and Kleinian groups
summary: Iteration of rational maps is matched term by term with the theory of Kleinian groups, so results and techniques of one side suggest and prove statements on the other.

name: Ribet and modularity
summary: Ribet shows Frey curve would contradict modularity.

name: Elliptic cohomology and topological modular forms
from: stable homotopy theory (complex cobordism, formal groups)
arithmetic of elliptic curves and modular forms
summary: Elliptic curves and modular forms are used to build cohomology theories that refine genera and are tied to string theory; Hopkins reported on them at the 2002 congress.

name: Noncommutative projective geometry (Artin-Schelter-Zhang)
summary: Graded noncommutative rings are studied through the quasi-coherent sheaves on a 'projective scheme' built from their modules.
